text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.

- Portuguese students of the third and fourth grade were less proficient in mathematics and sciences than most students abroad, according to a study including 26 countries conducted by Boston College.

- Prime Minister Antonio Guterres said he agrees with French Prime Minister Lionel Jospin's reservations about the "stability pact", and said the launch of the euro should be followed by coordinated policies to boost economic growth and employment.
- The state electricity company EDP - Electricidade de Portugal, about to be privatised, is already negotiating to reduce its workforce, the board said.

- EDP has a 10 percent stake in Colon Solar, a pioneer project to take advantage of solar power being built in Huelva, Spain. The Spanish electricity companies Endesa and Sevilhana together own 87 percent of its capital.
- The BVL 30 and BVL Geral indices rose 39.7 percent and 35.47 percent respectively since the end of 1996, indicating strong growth on Lisbon bourse.
